status: read-only CFEL candidate; no Event Record schema, Declaration, workflow, or runtime change made

exact_rule_text: `Kind//(c1, ...).p` selects p from the complete selected Kind instance population whose comma-separated conditions all hold. It is a filtered existing-record selection; it creates no record, relation, or Property.

A filter reference Property compared with a bound instance, such as `.object = $atom`, compares the resolved semantic target identity, never a raw ID, Carrier address, filename, or locator. The selected effective MODEL supplies that target-identity binding.

`MAX(selection)` accepts one typed timestamp scalar from each selected record and returns their latest instant. Compare instants after timezone/offset normalization; never lexically sort timestamp strings. Equal latest instants return that same instant and create no tie ambiguity.

MAX over an empty selection, an unknown/incomplete record population, a missing or multi-valued selected timestamp, or an invalid/non-timestamp value is an error. No such case is treated as a fallback value.
The query is a derived invariant only. It does not write or materialize Updated At, mutate Event Records, prescribe Workflow steps, or implement an Engine operation.

exact_claims.subject: Atom.Updated At
exact_claims.identity_binding: For `.object = $atom`, Atom target identity is the resolved pair (Atom.ID, Atom.Version), not bare Atom.ID or Carrier identity.

exact_claims.subject: Projection.Updated At
exact_claims.identity_binding: For `.object = $projection`, Projection target identity is resolved stable Projection.ID across rebuild representations, not a Carrier or rebuild-local identity.

schema_bindings_required_before_adoption: Event Record.Object: exactly one resolved reference target, with an identity-binding contract for Atom version identity and Projection stable identity.
Event Record.Action: exactly one admitted action literal that can be tested as `update`.
Event Record.timestamp: exactly one typed timestamp instant.
A complete authoritative Event Record population in the explicit Project/Journal evaluation context; Journal containment alone does not yet bind that population to a Project.
A resolution rule for whether `action = update` means accepted completed updates, including Projection rebuilds, while excluding no-op, failed, and archive records.

model_cases.name: atom-two-updates
model_cases.records: Two matching accepted update records resolve to the same Atom (ID A, Version 3), at 2026-11-01T09:00:00Z and 2026-11-01T10:00:00+01:00.
model_cases.result: MAX is the same instant 09:00Z; Atom.Updated At must equal that instant.

model_cases.name: atom-version-identity-not-bare-id
model_cases.records: A record targets Atom (ID A, Version 2) at 12:00Z; another targets Atom (ID A, Version 3) at 13:00Z.
model_cases.result: The Version-3 query selects only 13:00Z; the Version-2 event does not match by bare ID.

model_cases.name: projection-carrier-migration
model_cases.records: Two update records reference rebuild representations with stable Projection.ID P-7 but different Carrier locations, at 09:00Z and 11:00Z.
model_cases.result: Both match the Projection query; Updated At is 11:00Z.

model_cases.name: nonupdate-record-excluded
model_cases.records: A matching object has an update at 09:00Z and another event whose action is not update at 12:00Z.
model_cases.result: Only the update record contributes, subject to the pending action/outcome interpretation.

model_cases.name: equal-latest-timestamp
model_cases.records: Two matching update records have the same normalized instant 10:00Z.
model_cases.result: MAX is 10:00Z; no tie-breaker is needed because the scalar result is equal.

model_cases.name: empty-selection
model_cases.records: No matching update record exists for the target.
model_cases.result: error; required Updated At cannot be justified by an empty MAX.

model_cases.name: invalid-timestamp
model_cases.records: A matching update record has a malformed timestamp or two timestamp values.
model_cases.result: error; invalid data is not skipped.

model_cases.name: unknown-journal-population
model_cases.records: The evaluator cannot resolve the complete Project/Journal Event Record population.
model_cases.result: error; a partial Current-only or Carrier-local scan cannot satisfy the invariant.
